role: District Representative · Davao Occidental, Lone District
summary: Davao Occidental representative with 13 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant bills are a 20% discount and VAT exemption for military and PNP personnel and automatic fuel-tax relief with a pump-price subsidy. Evidence is limited to the economic dimension.
caveat: Two benefit and subsidy bills do not establish a broader economic pattern; no votes or statements reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Discount and VAT exemption for uniformed personnel (-1, state-provided benefit) and automatic fuel tax relief with a pump-price subsidy (-1, consumer subsidy). Narrow, benefit-focused; no labor or privatization evidence.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08379, HB08494 (retrieved 2026-11-01)
